egpPoints.point: Present simple affirmative, third person singular -s with common verbs
Present simple, increasing range/accuracy incl. spelling variants -es/-ies
egpPoints.egpLevel: A1-A2 (spelling not separately levelled in EGP; treated as A1 form, A2 accuracy)

outcomes.itemsTest: Mainly the A1 point: items 1,4,5,7-8 plain -s; items 2,3,6,9 -es/-ies spelling, which is an accuracy/spelling extension rather than a distinct A2 EGP point.
outcomes.recommended: A1 (or split: A1 core -s, A2 spelling/accuracy)
outcomes.evidence: Reference cites 'A1-A2'; matching spec items 1-9 show the core form is the A1 3rd-person -s with high-frequency A1 verbs.

egpPoints.point: Present continuous affirmative for actions happening now
Present continuous vs present simple contrast (e.g. 'Listen!' cue); negatives/questions wider range

outcomes.itemsTest: Both: items 1-3,5,7-8 test A1 affirmative am/is/are + -ing; item 4 (simple vs continuous choice) and 6 (bare verb for action now) touch the A2 contrast; item 9 reply is A1-A2.
outcomes.recommended: split (A1 form; A2 for simple/continuous contrast)
outcomes.evidence: Matching spec: 1 are+-ing, 2 am+-ing, 3 is+-ing, 4 choice simple vs continuous after Listen!, 5 be omitted, 6 bare verb for now.

egpPoints.point: Would like for polite requests/wants (I would like / I'd like)
CEFR CV Transactions to obtain goods and services: simple requests with please
egpPoints.egpLevel: A1 (A2 for routine shop/post office/bank transactions)

outcomes.itemsTest: The A1 points: fixed exponents Can I have ... please? and I would like ...; item 9 transfer (hotel/pharmacy/bank) leans to A2 CV transaction contexts.
outcomes.recommended: A1 (parent EN-L-A1-FN-polite-requests already A1); keep A2 only if transfer context is the target
outcomes.evidence: Outcome reference itself cites EGP 'can (requests), A1'; items 1-8 test fixed A1 formulae; lessonIds include RS-A1-FN-01.
